title: Bibliography: only APA 6th in en-US is checked against Word, and other cases are refused
symptom: an update rebuilds every citation and bibliography or refuses the whole document, naming the style, source and locale it cannot render; APA 6th covers the 17 source kinds, the 11 other styles a book by one author with title, year, city and publisher, and only APA 6th in en-US is compared with Word's own results (the entry order and a trailing space of patent entries still differ)
workaround: update the fields in Word, which rebuilds citations and the bibliography in any style
